targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(UsageDateUtc AS datetime2) AS time, SUM(TechnicalAccessCount) AS TechnicalAccessCount, SUM(OtherAccessCount) AS OtherAccessCount FROM report.vTableUsageDaily WHERE ServerInstance='$ServerInstance' AND DatabaseName='$DatabaseName' AND $__timeFilter(CAST(UsageDateUtc AS datetime2)) GROUP BY UsageDateUtc ORDER BY UsageDateUtc;

SELECT TOP (50) SchemaName,TableName,SUM(AccessCount) AS AccessCount,SUM(TechnicalAccessCount) AS TechnicalAccessCount,SUM(OtherAccessCount) AS OtherAccessCount FROM report.vTableUsageDaily WHERE ServerInstance='$ServerInstance' AND DatabaseName='$DatabaseName' AND $__timeFilter(CAST(UsageDateUtc AS datetime2)) GROUP BY SchemaName,TableName ORDER BY AccessCount DESC;

SELECT TOP (50) SchemaName,TableName,SUM(AccessCount) AS AccessCount,SUM(TechnicalAccessCount) AS TechnicalAccessCount,CAST(100.0*SUM(TechnicalAccessCount)/NULLIF(SUM(AccessCount),0) AS decimal(9,2)) AS TechnicalPercent FROM report.vTableUsageDaily WHERE ServerInstance='$ServerInstance' AND DatabaseName='$DatabaseName' AND $__timeFilter(CAST(UsageDateUtc AS datetime2)) GROUP BY SchemaName,TableName HAVING SUM(AccessCount)>0 ORDER BY TechnicalPercent DESC,AccessCount DESC;

list.name: ServerInstance
list.label: Instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT I.ServerInstance AS __text,I.ServerInstance AS __value FROM perf.TableUsageTarget T JOIN dbo.Instance I ON I.InstanceId=T.InstanceId WHERE T.IsEnabled=1 ORDER BY I.ServerInstance;

list.name: DatabaseName
list.label: Database
list.query: SELECT T.DatabaseName AS __text,T.DatabaseName AS __value FROM perf.TableUsageTarget T JOIN dbo.Instance I ON I.InstanceId=T.InstanceId WHERE T.IsEnabled=1 AND I.ServerInstance='$ServerInstance' ORDER BY T.DatabaseName;
